name: Viking® 5 Series 24" 5.5 Cu. Ft. Panel Ready Undercounter Beverage Center

Dynamic cooling technology delivers rapid cool down, frost-free operation, and temperature stability. The two 3-in-1 Split Convertible Shelves convert to wine racks with vibration neutralization. *CUSTOM PANEL & HANDLE SOLD SEPARATELY* *IMAGE MAY NOT REFLECT FINAL PRODUCT*
